title: エリザベス女王杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everything that happens from now on is real. That's why I have to make sure to witness it with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'll create striking memories for myself—for everyone! And I'll make each and every moment shine brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion doesn't finish her sentence, but it's enough. I understand exactly what she's feeling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day it was decided she would run in the Twinkle Series, Fine Motion's eyes sparkled brightly, and her excitement for the future swelled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she heads towards her glorious finale, she looks more beautiful than I can ever remember seeing her.
choice_data_list: Go out there and have fun!
Go out there and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm going to stop you there. Please save the "Today is an auspicious day!" formalities.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There's only one thing I want to know, Fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do you have the determination to face the Empress on this honorable stage?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course, Air Groove. Now, today is an auspicious day. And, from the bottom of my heart…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm honored for the chance to compete against you in a race you hold in such high esteem.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph… Very well. Do you require an escort?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I can find my way. To the starting line and right past you to the finish!
